Contents

Included sections: 10 · Admin Portal, 20 · User Web Portal, 30 · User App, 40 · Checker App, 50 · System-initiated, 60 · Cross-cutting. The remaining sections can be added by re-running the build with a wider scope.

10 Admin PortalFeatures started by BCB/BS23 staff in the Angular admin portal (rvl-gobcb-admin-portal), Admin Cognito pool. 20 User Web PortalFeatures started by customers in the Angular user portal (rvl-gobcb-user-portal/ETP-Web), User Cognito pool. 30 User AppFeatures started by customers in the Flutter user app (rvl-gobcb-user-app), User Cognito pool. 40 Checker AppFeatures used by gate staff in the Flutter checker app (rvl-gobcb-checker-app), TicketChecker Cognito pool. 50 System-initiatedWork no person starts directly: background workers on timers and SQS queue consumers. 60 Cross-cuttingConcerns shared by many features: sign-in, access control, service-to-service calls, storage, messaging, logging, cache, configuration.
